data_gap.note_zh: 本图层刻意保持空集合。公开资料尚无可引用的控规控制线、文保范围、道路红线、权属地块、现状补给设施、开放时间、无障碍连续路径、环卫排水条件与运营点位几何。取得官方或清权数据前，空集合优于编造；所有节点、廊道和功能覆盖仅作概念建议。
data_gap.note_en: This layer is intentionally empty. The public package contains no citable geometry for regulatory controls, heritage zones, road redlines, parcels, current supply facilities, actual opening hours, end-to-end accessible routes, sanitation/drainage conditions, or operating points. An empty layer is preferred to fabrication; all nodes, corridors, and programme overlays remain conceptual.

dignity_supply_geometry_contract.meaning: 空间只表达补给、保管、补货和压力测试的生产关系，不证明真实点位、产权、开放时间或运营承诺。
dignity_supply_geometry_contract.meaning_en: Geometry shows the production relationship among supply, custody, replenishment and stress testing only; it proves no real site, title, opening hour or operating commitment.
